summary: Tested the view_schedule permission-leak fix on both backend and frontend. Root cause is confirmed fixed: FULL_PERMISSION_MAPPING['manage_courses'] no longer grants manage_schedule, and only manage_schedule expands to view_schedule. /auth/me for Saeed (department_head) and Salim (dean) contains neither view_schedule nor manage_schedule. Backend guards behave as specified: weekly-schedule returns 403 for Saeed and Salim; all-schedule returns 403 for Salim and 200 for Saeed (via manage_attendance); admin gets 200 on both; a teacher gets 200 for their own teacher_id, 403 without teacher_id, and 200 on all-schedule; Saeed's teacher_id lookup is allowed through his course/teacher permissions. Granting and then revoking view_schedule on the role رئيس قسم works end to end (backend and UI), and the role was restored to its exact original permissions. Frontend: for Salim and Saeed the side menu hides الجدول الدراسي, الجدول الأسبوعي and إزاحة اليوم; the dash-kpi-today card does not navigate; /schedule and /weekly-schedule redirect to /no-permission with the right reason. Admin can see and open both pages. /manage-attendance loads for Saeed, and the weekly report modal in /teacher-courses loads for Saeed (weekly-schedule?teacher_id returns 200). The manage-roles audit for رئيس قسم shows menu-schedule and menu-weekly-schedule as غير ممنوحة. One new leak was found: GET /api/weekly-schedule/export-visual/{fmt} has no view_schedule guard.

critical.issue: Permission bypass. Salim (no view_schedule or manage_schedule) gets 200 and a ~10KB Excel of the whole weekly schedule without any teacher_id. The full schedule can be exported even though GET /api/weekly-schedule correctly returns 403. Apply the same guard as get_weekly_schedule (view_schedule or manage_schedule, with the own-teacher and staff+teacher_id exceptions).

minor.issue: Returns 200 with the draft list (names and notes) to Salim, who has no schedule permissions. It should require manage_schedule (or at least view_schedule).
Return 200 to Salim without view_schedule. Probably intended (dashboard and settings use them), but under the user's 'strict explicit permissions' requirement these should be reviewed.
An invalid ObjectId (e.g. /api/lectures/month) causes a 500 bson InvalidId error. It should return 400 or 404.

issues: A user with only view_schedule still sees the management tabs (الفترات / القاعات / تفضيلات المعلمين). The page has only a canView guard and no canManage gating. Backend writes are guarded by can_manage_schedule, so this is UX only.

action_items: Add the view_schedule/manage_schedule guard (same exceptions as GET /weekly-schedule) to GET /api/weekly-schedule/export-visual/{fmt}. HIGH: it is the remaining data leak.
Optional: hide the weekly-schedule management tabs for users without manage_schedule.
Optional: return 400/404 instead of 500 for an invalid ObjectId in /api/lectures/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: BottomNavBar in SideMenu.tsx is unused anywhere (dead code), so the canSchedule check on bottom-nav-schedule has no visible effect. The real bottom bar (الرئيسية/الإعدادات/المقررات/حسابي) has no schedule button.

frontend weekly-schedule.tsx guard has no teacher exception while schedule.tsx does. This is consistent with the backend (a teacher without teacher_id gets 403), but teachers are blocked from web login anyway.

The staff exception in GET /weekly-schedule (teacher_id + view_courses/view_teachers) lets anyone with view_courses read any teacher's schedule by id. This is by design for /teacher-courses, but should be documented.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested checks (10/10 pytest); 1 additional leak found outside the stated scope

seed_data_creation: None. The role رئيس قسم (698c93119a944c07ac7f80c3) was temporarily given view_schedule and then restored to the exact original permission list (verified equal).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_schedule_permission_leak.py (-p no:xdist -o addopts=''). Teachers (222222) cannot log into the web (backend returns 403 by design), so test teacher paths via the API. /teacher-courses requires ?teacherId=. The dash-kpi-today card is on the 'الأداء الأكاديمي' dashboard tab. Use ui195_role_toggle.py grant/revert for UI grant tests (it stores the original permissions in /tmp/role195_orig.json).
rca of the issue: The leak came from implicit expansion: manage_courses -> manage_schedule -> view_schedule in FULL_PERMISSION_MAPPING, so any role with manage_courses (department_head, dean) silently got schedule access. shift_day was never in that chain, which is why it stayed hidden. The fix removes manage_schedule from manage_courses' expansion and adds explicit backend guards. Residual: export-visual was not guarded.
